newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Centennial says buys into Queensland mine.
newsitem.headline: Centennial says buys into Queensland mine.

text.p: New South Wales coal miner Centennial Coal Co Ltd said on Tuesday it has purchased a half interest in Queensland coal miner Cook Resource Mining Pty Ltd for A$5.5 million.
Glencore said it would operate the high quality coking and steaming coal group, which owns and operates the Cook Colliery and Leichhardt coal preparation plant in central Queensland.
It also planned to invest a further A$3.0 million, along with commodities house Glencore International AG which owns the remaining 50 percent, to boost production and efficiency.
Centennial has also negotiated a five-year pre-emptive right to buy the nearby Yarrabee mine, which is also owned by Cook vendor, Resource Management & Mining Pty Ltd.
Centennial said in a statement the deal would allow it to diversify into Queensland and high quality coking coal in an opeation with scope for turnaround opportunities.
